---
title: "Tutorials"
---

Tutorials are **learning-oriented**: lessons that take you through a task
step by step, assuming little prior knowledge, and leaving you with
something working.

They complement — not replace — the [how-to guides](../how-to/index.qmd),
which assume you already know the basics and just need the steps.

## Available tutorials

### [Your first look at BC health data](first-look.qmd)

A guided walkthrough of exploring a headline health indicator for BC:
fetching it from a catalogued source, building the tidy dataset, reading
its trajectory and regimes, and reading it alongside its caveats.
*Covers mortality rates, life expectancy, and the survey family, with
references to regional indicators.*
